title: Synthesis Without Training: An Inference-Only Pipeline for Tabular, Temporal, and Relational Synthetic Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.38414v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic data generation is dominated by the fit-then-sample paradigm: a generative model is trained on a private dataset and then sampled from. Despite its widespread adoption, this paradigm faces three challenges: (1) a new training run is required for every dataset; (2) different data modalities, such as single tables, time series, and relational databases, require task-specific models and feature engineering; and (3) the resulting model is opaque, making its behavior under data constraints difficult to inspect. We propose GENSCRIPT, an inference-only pipeline that eliminates model training. GENSCRIPT computes a deterministic statistical profile of the source data (column types, ranges, missingness, categories, correlations, etc.) and passes it--rather than raw rows--to a language model to infer field semantics and cross-column integrity constraints. A coding agent then compiles the profile and constraints into an executable, auditab

translated_title: 无需训练的合成：面向表格、时间序列与关系型合成数据的纯推理流水线
translated_abstract: 合成数据生成目前由“先拟合后采样”范式主导：即在私有数据集上训练一个生成式模型，然后再从该模型中采样。尽管这一范式被广泛采用，但它面临三个挑战：(1) 每个数据集都需要一次新的训练；(2) 不同的数据模态（如单表、时间序列和关系数据库）需要任务专用的模型和特征工程；(3) 所得到的模型是不透明的，导致其在数据约束下的行为难以审查。我们提出了GENSCRIPT，一个无需模型训练的纯推理流水线。GENSCRIPT计算源数据的确定性统计概况（列类型、取值范围、缺失情况、类别、相关性等），并将其——而非原始数据行——传递给语言模型，以推断字段语义和跨列完整性约束。随后，一个编码智能体将统计概况和约束编译为可执行、可审计的（原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出了GENSCRIPT，一个无需任何模型训练的纯推理合成数据生成流水线，它通过将源数据的统计概况与完整性约束交给语言模型和编码智能体，统一支持表格、时间序列和关系型等多种数据模态的合成。
en_tdlr: GENSCRIPT is a training-free, inference-only pipeline that synthesizes tabular, temporal, and relational data by feeding deterministic statistical profiles and integrity constraints to a language model and a coding agent, eliminating the need for per-dataset generative model training.
